mapper.select: SELECT dr.record_date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(di.calories), 0) AS calories FROM diet_record dr LEFT JOIN diet_item di ON di.record_id = dr.id AND di.delete_flag = 0 WHERE dr.user_id = #{userId} AND dr.record_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND dr.delete_flag = 0 GROUP BY dr.record_date ORDER BY dr.record_date ASC
